purpose: Define a deterministic independent Stage1-to-Stage2 IR transport boundary that cannot be emitted or accepted while any typed semantic lane is incomplete.

envelope.reason: The bootstrap language currently has no proven SHA primitive; byte-for-byte determinism and structural counts are the in-compiler acceptance boundary, while external qualification may add hashes.

determinism_rules: functions serialize in canonical function order
semantic values serialize by ascending semantic value ID
blocks serialize in canonical block ID order
instructions serialize by ascending instruction ID
call linkage records serialize by defining instruction ID
terminators serialize by owner block ID
no hash-map iteration or host-dependent ordering is permitted
identical complete Stage1 IR must serialize byte-for-byte identically
stage1_emission_rules: do not emit the S3IR2 magic unless completeness_mask == 15
all header counts must equal verifier-approved semantic counts
no legacy lexical/event lane may be serialized as if it were a typed semantic section
serialization failure emits no partial Stage2-authoritative artifact
stage2_acceptance_rules: reject unknown magic or schema version
reject any value use without a valid definition
reject instruction/block/call/terminator cross-reference outside declared bounds
reject trailing or missing records relative to header counts
prohibited_shortcuts: Stage2 rereads Stage1 source to recover missing semantics
Stage2 accepts aggregate Stage1 event records as typed instructions
Stage1 emits a partial envelope with missing completeness bits
Stage2 begins before independent parser/validator tests exist
